syllabusExamples.cn: 请告诉我们应该做什么来保护我们的环境。

example.cn: 我们骑车上学，为保护环境出一份力。

sourceMeaning: n. （笔头、口头或操作）考试， 测   试；检查

syllabusExamples.en: After we pass the exams, we will celebrate by having a party next week.
syllabusExamples.cn: 我们通过考试后，下周将举办个派对庆祝一下。

example.en: I have a maths exam on Friday morning.
example.cn: 我周五上午有一场数学考试。

sourceMeaning: adj. 昂贵的； 价格高的

example.en: These boots are too expensive for my budget.
example.cn: 这双靴子太贵，超出了我的预算。

syllabusExamples.en: The people there did not allow them to set up a factory so as not to pollute the water in the river.
syllabusExamples.cn: 为防止污染河水，那里的人不允许他们在那儿建立工厂。

example.en: My aunt works at a factory that makes bicycles.
example.cn: 我姑姑在一家生产自行车的工厂工作。

sourceMeaning: n. 家庭； 家族；家人

syllabusExamples.en: I will take a holiday with my family as I finish all the exams.
syllabusExamples.cn: 考试一结束，我就会与家人一起去度假。

syllabusExamples.en: The family are very pleased about the news.

example.en: My family gathers around the kitchen table every Sunday.
example.cn: 我的家人每周日都会围坐在厨房的餐桌旁。

syllabusExamples.en: Uncle Tom is a farmer. He keeps many sheep on his farm and leads a happy life.
syllabusExamples.cn: 汤姆叔叔是个农民。他在农场养了许多羊，且过着幸福的生活。

example.en: We bought fresh eggs from a nearby farm.
example.cn: 我们从附近的农场买了新鲜鸡蛋。

syllabusExamples.en: The farmer looked sadly at the flooded field and he became sadder and sadder.
syllabusExamples.cn: 这个农民忧郁地望着被洪水淹没的田地，他变得越来越悲伤。

example.en: The farmer feeds her chickens before the sun rises.
example.cn: 这位农民在日出前给她的鸡喂食。

syllabusExamples.en: Wendy's father helped her invent a new way of doing business.
syllabusExamples.cn: 温迪的父亲帮助她发明了一种新的经商方式。

example.en: Her father taught her to ride a bicycle.
example.cn: 她爸爸教她骑自行车。

syllabusExamples.en: Could you tell me when the film will start tomorrow evening?
syllabusExamples.cn: 你能否告诉我明天晚上的电影什么时候放映？

example.en: We watched a funny film after dinner yesterday.
example.cn: 昨天晚饭后，我们看了一部有趣的电影。

sourceMeaning: n. 火； 火炉； 火灾

syllabusExamples.en: Without fires, the oldest and largest trees would stop sunlight from reaching the forest floor. Fires can get rid of some of these old trees.
syllabusExamples.cn: 没有火，那些古老而高大的树会阻挡阳光透入森林，而火恰恰能烧掉这些老树。

syllabusExamples.en: The officer ordered his men to fire at the enemy.
syllabusExamples.cn: 军官命令士兵向敌人开火。

syllabusExamples.en: There is no smoke without fire.
syllabusExamples.cn: 无风不起浪。

example.en: We warmed our hands by the fire after dinner.
example.cn: 晚饭后，我们在炉火旁暖手。

syllabusExamples.en: Damin taught his grandsons how they could catch more fish.
= Damin taught his grandsons how to catch more fish.
syllabusExamples.cn: 达明教他的孙子如何能捕到更多的鱼。

syllabusExamples.en: It is better to teach a man to fish than to give him fish.
syllabusExamples.cn: 授人以鱼，不如授人以渔。

example.en: We watched small fish swimming under the wooden bridge.
example.cn: 我们看着小鱼在木桥下游动。

sourceMeaning: n. 地面；地板；（楼房的）层

syllabusExamples.en: I have bought a new flat and it's on the eighth floor of the building.
syllabusExamples.cn: 我买了一套新公寓，它在这栋楼的8楼。

example.en: My keys fell onto the kitchen floor again.
example.cn: 我的钥匙又掉到厨房地板上了。

syllabusExamples.en: There were so many beautiful flowers on show at the park yesterday.
syllabusExamples.cn: 昨天在公园有这么多美丽的鲜花展示。

example.en: She placed fresh flowers in a vase by the window.
example.cn: 她把鲜花插进窗边的花瓶里。

syllabusExamples.en: This truck is used to deliver frozen food from the factory to the supermarket.
syllabusExamples.cn: 这辆卡车是用来将冷冻食品从工厂运送到超市的。

example.en: We packed enough food for a picnic by the lake.
example.cn: 我们带了足够的食物，准备在湖边野餐。

syllabusExamples.en: The air in the forest is much fresher than that in the city.
syllabusExamples.cn: 森林里的空气比城市中的要清新得多。

example.en: We followed a narrow path deep into the forest.
example.cn: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路走进森林深处。

syllabusExamples.en: The lady over there is a friend of mine.
syllabusExamples.cn: 那边的那位女士是我的一个朋友。

syllabusExamples.en: A friend of hers visited Beijing three days ago.
syllabusExamples.cn: 她的一位朋友3天前游览了北京。

syllabusExamples.en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
syllabusExamples.cn: 患难见真情。

example.en: I met an old friend at the market yesterday.
example.cn: 我昨天在市场遇到了一位老朋友。

syllabusExamples.en: It's important to eat a variety of fruits and vegetables.
syllabusExamples.cn: 吃各种各样的水果和蔬菜很重要。

example.en: She packed fresh fruit in my lunch box.
example.cn: 她在我的午餐盒里放了新鲜水果。

syllabusExamples.en: How happily Little Tommy is playing with his cousin in the garden!
syllabusExamples.cn: 小汤米和他的表弟在花园里玩耍多么快乐！

example.en: We picked fresh beans from the garden before lunch.
example.cn: 午饭前，我们从菜园里摘了新鲜的豆角。

syllabusExamples.en: It was unusual for such a little girl to solve this hard problem in ten minutes.
syllabusExamples.cn: 对于这样一个小女孩，在10分钟内就解决了这个棘手的问题，太不寻常了。

example.en: The girl carefully carried her kitten into the house.
example.cn: 那个女孩小心翼翼地把小猫抱进屋里。

syllabusExamples.en: She was very frightened at the sight of a snake on the grass.
syllabusExamples.cn: 看到草地上的蛇，她很害怕。

example.en: We spread a blanket on the grass beside the river.
example.cn: 我们在河边的草地上铺了一条毯子。

syllabusExamples.en: She was trying to teach him to play the guitar.
syllabusExamples.cn: 她在试着教他弹吉他。

example.en: My sister plays the guitar beside the window every evening.
example.cn: 我姐姐每天晚上都在窗边弹吉他。

syllabusExamples.en: I have a terrible headache.
syllabusExamples.cn: 我头痛得厉害。

example.en: I have a headache, so I need some quiet.
example.cn: 我头痛，需要安静一会儿。

sourceMeaning: n. 健康；身体（或精神）状况

syllabusExamples.en: Smoking is harmful to our health.
syllabusExamples.cn: 吸烟有害健康。

example.en: Walking to work has really improved my health.
example.cn: 步行上班确实改善了我的健康状况。

syllabusExamples.en: Healthy eating and doing exercise every day can keep us fit.
syllabusExamples.cn: 健康饮食和每天运动能让我们保持健康。

example.en: Our cat stays healthy with regular exercise and checkups.
example.cn: 我们家的猫通过经常运动和定期检查保持健康。

syllabusExamples.en: Can you speak louder, please? I can't hear you clearly.
syllabusExamples.cn: 你可以大声一点吗？我听不清楚。

syllabusExamples.en: —Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.
We heard two people arguing when we walked past that area.
syllabusExamples.cn: 当我们走过那个地方的时候，听到两人正在争论。

syllabusExamples.en: I hear him talking next door.
syllabusExamples.cn: 我听到他正在隔壁房间讲话。

syllabusExamples.en: Would you ask her to sing a song for us? We'd like to hear her sing like a sporano.
syllabusExamples.cn: 你能让她为我们唱一首歌吗？我们喜欢听她像女高音那样唱。

syllabusExamples.en: Do you hear someone knocking at the door?
syllabusExamples.cn: （讲时还在敲）

syllabusExamples.en: I heard someone knock at the door three times.
syllabusExamples.cn: （讲时敲的动作已结束）

example.en: I can hear birds singing outside my bedroom window.
example.cn: 我能听见卧室窗外的鸟鸣声。

syllabusExamples.en: Can you help me to get some help?
syllabusExamples.cn: 你能帮我找人帮个忙吗？

syllabusExamples.en: Professor Wang personally thanked everyone who helped with the project.
syllabusExamples.cn: 王教授亲自向所有为这个项目提供过帮助的人表示了感谢。

syllabusExamples.en: The students have recently finished their group project with the teacher's help.
syllabusExamples.cn: 在老师的帮助下，同学们最近完成了他们的小组课题。

example.en: Could you help me carry these bags upstairs?
example.cn: 你能帮我把这些袋子提上楼吗？

syllabusExamples.en: —I will fly to Qingdao for my holiday this weekend.

example.en: We spent our holiday swimming and exploring quiet villages.
example.cn: 我们假期里游泳，还探访了宁静的村庄。

syllabusExamples.en: Frank works with others from home through computers.
syllabusExamples.cn: 弗兰克在家里通过电脑与其他人联系办公。

syllabusExamples.en: We have spent all our money, so we have to walk home now.
syllabusExamples.cn: 我们已经花光了所有的钱，所以现在不得不步行回家。

example.en: We walked home together after dinner at the café.
example.cn: 在咖啡馆吃过晚饭后，我们一起走回家。

syllabusExamples.en: Don't go out of the classroom until your homework is finished.
syllabusExamples.cn: 做完家庭作业前不准离开教室。

example.en: I finished my homework before dinner and went outside.
example.cn: 我在晚饭前做完了作业，然后出门了。

syllabusExamples.en: When the horse finished the race, its sides were wet all over with sweat.
syllabusExamples.cn: 当这匹马跑完比赛，它浑身上下都是汗水。

example.en: The brown horse gently took an apple from my hand.
example.cn: 那匹棕色的马轻轻地吃走了我手里的苹果。

syllabusExamples.en: The doctors in that hospital always examine patients with great care.
syllabusExamples.cn: 该院医生总是细心地为患者检查身体。

example.en: She works as a nurse at the local hospital.
example.cn: 她在当地医院当护士。

syllabusExamples.en: In such hot weather, people live comfortably with air conditioners.
syllabusExamples.cn: 在如此炎热的天气里，空调使人们生活舒适。

syllabusExamples.en: This curry is very hot.
syllabusExamples.cn: 这咖喱特别辣。

example.en: Be careful; the soup is still very hot.
example.cn: 小心，汤还很烫。

syllabusExamples.en: The Magic Hotel is amazing because it's completely underwater.
syllabusExamples.cn: 魔术酒店很奇妙，因为它完全在水下。

example.en: Our hotel room overlooks a quiet sandy beach.
example.cn: 我们住的酒店房间可以俯瞰一片宁静的沙滩。

syllabusExamples.en: What good news it is! The government is planning to build more low-cost houses for its people.
syllabusExamples.cn: 政府正计划为本国人民建造更多低价住房。真是好消息啊！

example.en: Their house has a small garden behind the kitchen.
example.cn: 他们的房子在厨房后面有一个小花园。

syllabusExamples.en: The animals can go hungry because their food has been damaged in the forest fire.
syllabusExamples.cn: 因为食物在这次森林火灾中遭到破坏，所以动物们可能要挨饿了。

example.en: I felt hungry after our long walk by the river.
example.cn: 在河边走了很久之后，我觉得饿了。

sourceMeaning: adj. 有病的； 不健康的

syllabusExamples.en: John is seriously ill, so you ought to spend more time caring for him these days.
syllabusExamples.cn: 约翰病得很重，所以这些天你应该多花些时间照顾他。

example.en: I felt ill after the long bus journey.
example.cn: 长途乘车后，我感到身体不适。

syllabusExamples.en: Taiwan is the biggest island of China. I hope to visit it soon.
syllabusExamples.cn: 台湾是中国最大的岛屿。我希望不久能参观这座岛。

example.en: We took a small boat to the island yesterday.
example.cn: 昨天我们乘小船去了那座岛。

syllabusExamples.en: The local government is planning to create more jobs for young people.
syllabusExamples.cn: 当地政府正计划为年轻人创造更多的就业机会。

syllabusExamples.en: He got a job as a waiter.
syllabusExamples.cn: 他找到一份服务员的工作。

syllabusExamples.en: Cooking is not an easy job.
syllabusExamples.cn: 做饭不是一件容易的事。

example.en: My sister found a job at the local library.
example.cn: 我姐姐在当地图书馆找到了一份工作。

example.en: She squeezed fresh orange juice into a glass.
example.cn: 她把鲜橙汁挤进了玻璃杯里。

sourceMeaning: n. （计算机或打字机的）键盘

syllabusExamples.en: The keyboard is used to put information into the computer.
syllabusExamples.cn: 键盘用于把信息输入电脑。

example.en: I brushed the crumbs off my keyboard before starting work.
example.cn: 开始工作前，我把键盘上的碎屑刷掉了。

syllabusExamples.en: Billy, is your mother cooking meat in the kitchen? It smells so nice!
syllabusExamples.cn: 比利，你妈妈是不是在厨房炖肉？味道很香！

example.en: The kitchen smells of fresh bread and roasted vegetables.
example.cn: 厨房里飘着新鲜面包和烤蔬菜的香味。

syllabusExamples.en: The lake looks beautiful in the moonlight. I often take a walk around it.
syllabusExamples.cn: 在月光下湖看起来很漂亮。我经常沿着湖散步。

example.en: We rented a small boat and crossed the lake.
example.cn: 我们租了一条小船，划到了湖对岸。

syllabusExamples.en: It goes without saying that studying vocabulary is a key part of language learning.
syllabusExamples.cn: 不用说也知道，学习词汇是学习语言的一个主要部分。

example.en: My neighbour teaches me a little of her language.
example.cn: 邻居教我一点她的语言。

syllabusExamples.en: In some English classes, pictures are used to help the students learn new words.
syllabusExamples.cn: 在一些英语课上，图片被用来辅助学生学习新单词。

syllabusExamples.en: We soon learned how to grow organic vegetables.
=We soon learned how they grew organic vegetables.
syllabusExamples.cn: 我们很快就学会如何种植有机蔬菜。

syllabusExamples.en: Learn young, learn fair.
syllabusExamples.cn: 学习趁年轻，学就要学好。

example.en: My grandfather is learning to swim at the local pool.
example.cn: 我爷爷正在附近的游泳池学游泳。

syllabusExamples.en: If Tony isn't careful enough with his lesson, more mistakes will be made later.
syllabusExamples.cn: 托尼如果不仔细做功课，他以后将犯更多的错误。

example.en: Our swimming lesson starts after school on Thursday.
example.cn: 我们的游泳课在周四放学后开始。

syllabusExamples.en: ——What did your son say in the letter?

example.en: A letter from my sister arrived this morning.
example.cn: 今天早上，我收到了姐姐寄来的信。

sourceMeaning: n. 图书馆， 图书室

syllabusExamples.en: I' ve borrowed two books from our school library.
syllabusExamples.cn: 我从学校图书馆借了2本书。

example.en: I borrowed three books from the library after school.
example.cn: 放学后，我从图书馆借了三本书。

syllabusExamples.en: She was frightened by the roars of a lion.
syllabusExamples.cn: 她被狮子的吼叫声吓呆了。

example.en: The lion rested beneath a tree in the shade.
example.cn: 那头狮子在树荫下休息。

syllabusExamples.en: How wonderful the music is! I will listen to it again.
syllabusExamples.cn: 这音乐多么美妙！我会再听一遍的。

example.en: I listen to music while cooking dinner every evening.
example.cn: 每天晚上做饭时，我都会听音乐。

syllabusExamples.en: Nobody at the lunch table believed the truth of his story.
syllabusExamples.cn: 在午餐桌上，没人相信他的故事是真的。

example.en: We ate lunch under a tree beside the river.
example.cn: 我们在河边的一棵树下吃了午饭。

syllabusExamples.en: Look at the photo! The fifth man from the right is my class teacher.
syllabusExamples.cn: 看照片！从右边起第五个男人是我的班主任。

syllabusExamples.en: No man is born wise or learned.
syllabusExamples.cn: 人非生而知之。

example.en: A man in a blue coat held the door open.
example.cn: 一位穿蓝色外套的男子扶着门，让别人通过。

syllabusExamples.en: Where is the nearest market?
syllabusExamples.cn: 最近的集市在哪儿?

example.en: We bought fresh peaches at the market this morning.
example.cn: 今天早上我们在集市买了新鲜桃子。

syllabusExamples.en: “Mr. Zhu, you'd better not eat too much meat. You are already overweight,” said the doctor.
syllabusExamples.cn: 医生说：“朱先生，您最好不要吃太多的肉。您已经超重了。”

example.en: We keep raw meat separate from vegetables in the fridge.
example.cn: 我们把生肉和蔬菜分开放在冰箱里。

syllabusExamples.en: Could you give us another menu?
syllabusExamples.cn: 你可以再给我们一份菜单吗？

example.en: There are several vegetarian dishes on the menu.
example.cn: 菜单上有几道素菜。

syllabusExamples.en: I telephoned Jane just now, but she wasn't in. I had to leave her a message.
syllabusExamples.cn: 刚才我打电话给简，但她不在，我不得不给她留下口信。

example.en: Please leave a message if I miss your call.
example.cn: 如果我没接到你的电话，请留言。

syllabusExamples.en: Peter doesn't need any money from his parents because he has found a good job and can earn money by himself.
syllabusExamples.cn: 彼得不必向他的父母要钱，因为他已经找到一份好工作，可以自己挣钱。

example.en: I saved enough money to buy a new bicycle.
example.cn: 我攒够了买一辆新自行车的钱。

syllabusExamples.en: The monkey was swinging in the tree.
syllabusExamples.cn: 猴子在树上荡来荡去。

example.en: A little monkey swung between branches above our heads.
example.cn: 一只小猴子在我们头顶的树枝间荡来荡去。

syllabusExamples.en: What shape is the moon, Mike?
syllabusExamples.cn: 迈克，月亮是什么形状的？

example.en: The moon rose slowly above the trees behind our house.
example.cn: 月亮在我们屋后的树梢上缓缓升起。

syllabusExamples.en: My mother is nearly 80 and she's starting to get a bit forgetful.
syllabusExamples.cn: 我的母亲近80岁，她开始有点健忘。

syllabusExamples.en: Diligence is the mother of success.
syllabusExamples.cn: 勤奋是成功之母。

example.en: My mother taught me how to ride a bicycle.
example.cn: 我妈妈教会了我骑自行车。

sourceMeaning: n. 山； 高山； 山脉

syllabusExamples.en: On the Double Ninth Festival, people usually climb mountains.
syllabusExamples.cn: 在重阳节，人们通常去爬山。

example.en: Snow covered the mountain even in the middle of summer.
example.cn: 即使在盛夏，那座山仍被白雪覆盖。

syllabusExamples.en: The baby likes to watch Mickey Mouse cartoons best.
syllabusExamples.cn: 宝宝最喜欢看米老鼠卡通片了。

example.en: A tiny mouse slipped behind the cupboard before breakfast.
example.cn: 早饭前，一只小老鼠溜到了橱柜后面。

syllabusExamples.en: The music he was playing was so beautiful. We all lost ourselves in it.
syllabusExamples.cn: 他演奏的音乐是如此优美。我们都陶醉了。

example.en: Soft music drifted through the kitchen while we cooked.
example.cn: 我们做饭时，轻柔的音乐在厨房里飘荡。

syllabusExamples.cn: 李平的母亲是护士还是医生？

example.cn: 护士轻轻地用绷带包住我的手腕。

syllabusExamples.en: Jack is such a forgetful fellow, for he always leaves this or that at the office.
syllabusExamples.cn: 杰克是一个健忘的家伙，因为他总把这个或那个东西落在办公室。

example.en: I left my umbrella under the desk at the office.
example.cn: 我把伞落在办公室的桌子下面了。

sourceMeaning: n. 橘子， 橙； 橙色

syllabusExamples.en: Orange juice contains things which help keep you healthy.
syllabusExamples.cn: 橘子汁里含有益于健康的东西。

syllabusExamples.en: I prefer that orange blouse.
syllabusExamples.cn: 我更喜欢那件橙色的女衬衫。

example.en: I peeled an orange and shared it with my sister.

syllabusExamples.en: The panda attracted many children.
syllabusExamples.cn: 那只熊猫吸引了不少孩子。

example.en: The panda sat quietly, chewing a fresh bamboo shoot.
example.cn: 那只大熊猫静静地坐着，嚼着一根新鲜竹笋。

syllabusExamples.cn: 他在一张纸上写了一个数字。

syllabusExamples.en: I read the news in the papers.
syllabusExamples.cn: 我在报纸上看到了这则消息。

example.en: She wrapped the small gift in bright yellow paper.
example.cn: 她用鲜黄色的纸把小礼物包了起来。

example.cn: 每位家长都为学校野餐带了一份点心。

syllabusExamples.cn: 史密斯先生认为，世纪公园是上海第二大公园。

syllabusExamples.cn: 他找到了一个停车位。

example.en: We shared a picnic under the trees in the park.
example.cn: 我们在公园的树下共进了野餐。

example.cn: 这些苹果可以刷卡付款吗？

syllabusExamples.cn: 学生被要求用钢笔做练习。

example.en: Could you lend me a pen for this form?
example.cn: 你能借我一支笔填这张表吗？

syllabusExamples.en: Who has taken my pencil away? I used it minutes ago.
syllabusExamples.cn: 谁拿了我的铅笔？几分钟前我还在用呢。

example.cn: 她削好铅笔，开始画那只熟睡的猫。

syllabusExamples.cn: 据报道，在这次的大地震中死亡人数已超过两千人。

example.en: Several people were waiting outside the bakery this morning.
example.cn: 今天早晨，有几个人在面包店外等候。

syllabusExamples.en: Doug's 14-year-old son Jamie answered the phone.
syllabusExamples.cn: 道格14岁的儿子杰米接了电话。

syllabusExamples.en: Yesterday he phoned Laura to see if she was better.
syllabusExamples.cn: 昨天他打电话给劳拉，问她是不是好些了。

example.en: My phone rang while I was washing the dishes.
example.cn: 我洗碗时，电话响了。

syllabusExamples.en: We took many photos at Grandpa's birthday party.
syllabusExamples.cn: 我们在爷爷的生日聚会上拍了很多照片。

example.en: We took a photo beside the old bridge.
example.cn: 我们在那座老桥旁拍了张照片。

syllabusExamples.en: Alice loves music. Every day she practises playing the piano for an hour.
syllabusExamples.cn: 爱丽丝热爱音乐。她每天练习弹钢琴一个小时。

example.en: My sister practises the piano after dinner every evening.
example.cn: 我姐姐每天晚饭后练钢琴。

sourceMeaning: n. 图片， 图画， 照片； 影片

syllabusExamples.en: I had a picture taken this morning.
syllabusExamples.cn: 今天上午我请人给我拍了张照片。

example.en: She hung a picture of the sea above her bed.
example.cn: 她在床头上方挂了一幅海景画。

syllabusExamples.en: He raises pigs for a living.
syllabusExamples.cn: 他以养猪为生。

example.en: A pink pig was sleeping beside the wooden fence.
example.cn: 一头粉色的猪正睡在木栅栏旁。

syllabusExamples.en: The pilot landed the plane safely at its home airport.
syllabusExamples.cn: 飞行员将飞机安全地降落在驻地机场。

example.en: Our plane landed just before the rain began.
example.cn: 我们的飞机刚降落，雨就下起来了。

syllabusExamples.en: After the heavy rain there were pools on the road.
syllabusExamples.cn: 大雨过后路上有一些小水塘。

example.en: We spent the afternoon swimming in the outdoor pool.
example.cn: 我们整个下午都在室外游泳池游泳。

syllabusExamples.en: Nowadays people complain that food prices are higher than before.
syllabusExamples.cn: 现在人们都抱怨食品价格比以前高了。

example.en: The price of fresh strawberries has fallen this week.
example.cn: 这周新鲜草莓的价格降了。

syllabusExamples.en: Well done! You have answered all the questions correctly.
syllabusExamples.cn: 干得好！你已正确回答了所有的问题。

example.en: I raised my hand to ask the teacher a question.
example.cn: 我举手向老师提了一个问题。

sourceMeaning: n. 无线电（广播）；收音机

syllabusExamples.en: Father bought her a stereo radio.
syllabusExamples.cn: 父亲给她买了台立体声收音机。

example.en: Dad keeps a small radio on the kitchen shelf.
example.cn: 爸爸在厨房架子上放着一台小收音机。

syllabusExamples.en: In fact, there isn't so much rain in the city as they think.
syllabusExamples.cn: 事实上，这座城市不像他们想的那样有这么多的雨水。

syllabusExamples.en: We will go to the Happy Valley tomorrow unless it rains.
syllabusExamples.cn: 如果明天不下雨，我们会去欢乐谷。

example.en: Heavy rain kept us inside for the whole afternoon.
example.cn: 大雨让我们整个下午都待在屋里。

syllabusExamples.en: It's easy to memorise the words if we know how to read them correctly.
syllabusExamples.cn: 如果我们知道如何正确地读出这些单词，就很容易记住它们了。

syllabusExamples.en: Tommy asked me if I was interested in reading science fiction.
syllabusExamples.cn: 汤米问我是否对读科幻小说感兴趣。

syllabusExamples.en: Jenny was reading the text of Lesson Three at 8:00 last night.
syllabusExamples.cn: 昨天晚上8点珍妮正在读第3课的课文。

syllabusExamples.en: Reading makes a full man.
syllabusExamples.cn: 读书长见识。

example.en: I read a few pages before bed every night.
example.cn: 我每天晚上睡前都会读几页书。

syllabusExamples.en: The famous singer died, but her sweet voice will be remembered for ever.
syllabusExamples.cn: 这位著名歌手去世了，但她甜美的声音将永远被铭记。

syllabusExamples.en: I remembered turning off the lights when I left the room.
Please remember to close the door when you go to bed.

example.en: I still remember the smell of my grandmother's kitchen.
example.cn: 我至今还记得祖母厨房里的气味。

syllabusExamples.en: I shall leave the restaurant unless the waiter comes soon.
=I shall leave the restaurant if the waiter doesn't come soon.
syllabusExamples.cn: 除非服务员马上来，否则我就离开饭店。

example.en: We found a quiet restaurant beside the river.
example.cn: 我们在河边找到了一家安静的餐馆。

syllabusExamples.en: The southerners prefer rice and the northerners prefer food made from flour.
syllabusExamples.cn: 南方人比较喜欢吃米饭，北方人爱吃面食。

example.en: We had rice with steamed fish for dinner.
example.cn: 我们晚餐吃了米饭和清蒸鱼。

syllabusExamples.en: These factories are trying their best not to pollute the river any longer.
syllabusExamples.cn: 这些工厂正在尽力不再污染河流。

example.en: We watched ducks swimming across the river this morning.
example.cn: 今天早上，我们看着鸭子游过河面。

syllabusExamples.en: We should drive carefully on the road.
syllabusExamples.cn: 在道路上我们应该小心驾驶。

syllabusExamples.en: Confidence in yourself is the first step on the road to success.

example.en: Look both ways before you cross the road.
example.cn: 过马路前要向两边看。

syllabusExamples.en: This is a three-metre-high room.
syllabusExamples.cn: 这是一个3米高的房间。

syllabusExamples.en: There is no room for your piano in your room.
syllabusExamples.cn: 你房间里没地方放钢琴了。

example.en: My room has a desk beside the window.
example.cn: 我的房间里，窗边有一张书桌。

syllabusExamples.en: Friends are the people you feel safe because you know they care about you.
syllabusExamples.cn: 朋友就是那些能让你有安全感的人，因为你知道他们关心你。

syllabusExamples.en: Only her husband knows the number to open the safe.
syllabusExamples.cn: 只有她丈夫知道打开保险柜的密码。

example.en: Your bike is safe inside our locked garage.
example.cn: 你的自行车放在我们锁好的车库里很安全。

syllabusExamples.en: “There's still a long way to go before you succeed,” the teacher said to the class.
syllabusExamples.cn: 老师对全班学生说：“在你们成功之前还有很长的路要走。”

syllabusExamples.en: Last but not least, at the end of the interview, don't forget to thank the interviewer and say goodbye.
syllabusExamples.cn: 最后但同样重要的是，在面试结束时，别忘了感谢面试官并说再见。

example.en: Please say your name again so I can remember it.
example.cn: 请再说一遍你的名字，好让我记住。

syllabusExamples.en: —John was seriously injured in the school bus accident.

example.en: We walk to school together along the river.
example.cn: 我们一起沿着河边步行上学。

syllabusExamples.en: You can see him on the TV screen quite often.
syllabusExamples.cn: 你可以经常在电视屏幕上见到他。

example.en: I wiped the fingerprints off my laptop screen.
example.cn: 我擦掉了笔记本电脑屏幕上的指纹。

syllabusExamples.en: We generally go to the sea for our holidays.
syllabusExamples.cn: 我们通常去海边度假。

example.en: The children watched small boats sailing across the sea.
example.cn: 孩子们看着小船在海上航行。

syllabusExamples.en: The book written by that writer didn't sell well last year.
syllabusExamples.cn: 那位作家写的这本书，去年销售情况不好。

example.en: They sell fresh bread at the market every Saturday.
example.cn: 他们每周六都在市场卖新鲜面包。

syllabusExamples.en: The old man used to raise many sheep to make a living in the west of China.
syllabusExamples.cn: 老人过去常常靠养羊在中国的西部谋生。

example.en: Several sheep were resting under a tree near the farm.
example.cn: 几只绵羊正在农场附近的一棵树下休息。

syllabusExamples.en: Are you going to America by plane or by ship the day after tomorrow?
syllabusExamples.cn: 后天你去美国是乘飞机还是坐船？

example.en: We watched a huge ship glide into the harbour.
example.cn: 我们看着一艘巨轮缓缓驶入港口。

syllabusExamples.en: It's not available in the shops.
syllabusExamples.cn: 商店里都没货。

syllabusExamples.en: He always shopped at that shop.
syllabusExamples.cn: 他总在那家商店购物。

example.en: The little shop near our house sells fresh bread.
example.cn: 我们家附近的小店卖新鲜面包。

sourceMeaning: adj. 有病的，患病的；（想）呕吐的，恶心的

syllabusExamples.cn: 在第12天，患病的男孩活过来了。

example.en: He stayed in bed because he felt sick this morning.
example.cn: 他今天早上觉得不舒服，所以一直躺在床上。

syllabusExamples.en: How beautifully you sing!
syllabusExamples.cn: 你唱得多美呀！

example.cn: 我们一边洗碗，一边唱自己最喜欢的歌。

syllabusExamples.cn: 她和她的妹妹一样聪明。

example.en: My younger sister always borrows my favourite blue jumper.
example.cn: 我妹妹总是借穿我最喜欢的蓝色毛衣。

syllabusExamples.en: A bright moving object appeared in the sky at sunset.
syllabusExamples.cn: 日落时分，天空中出现了一个移动的发亮物体。

example.en: The sky turned orange as we walked home.
example.cn: 我们步行回家时，天空变成了橙色。

syllabusExamples.en: The mountains were crowned with snow.
syllabusExamples.cn: 山上积满了雪。

syllabusExamples.en: In winter the more heavily it snows, the happier the children will feel.
syllabusExamples.cn: 在冬天雪下得越大，孩子们就会越快乐。

example.cn: 我们醒来时，新下的雪覆盖了花园。

syllabusExamples.en: Can you tell me who will speak at the class meeting next Monday?
syllabusExamples.cn: 你能否告诉我下星期一谁将在班会上发言？

syllabusExamples.en: Tom speaks French most fluently in his class.

syllabusExamples.cn: 汤姆在他班里是法语讲得最流利的。

example.en: Could I speak to you after the lesson?
example.cn: 下课后我能和你谈谈吗？

sourceMeaning: n. 春天，春季；泉水；弹簧

syllabusExamples.cn: 我在空气中闻到了春天的气息。

example.en: We plant flowers in the garden every spring.
example.cn: 我们每年春天都在花园里种花。

syllabusExamples.en: The sun is a star.
syllabusExamples.cn: 太阳是一颗恒星。

example.cn: 我们在湖边的帐篷里仰望星空。

syllabusExamples.cn: 你家离火车站有多远？

example.cn: 我们提着沉重的行李箱匆忙赶往车站。

syllabusExamples.cn: 我讨厌狗把街道搞得乱七八糟。

example.en: We crossed the street to reach the bakery.
example.cn: 我们穿过街道来到面包店。

syllabusExamples.cn: 学生通过自主探寻答案，能更高效地学习。

syllabusExamples.en: The students had an enjoyable time when they went for an outing.

syllabusExamples.cn: 我们可以在教室里学习。

syllabusExamples.cn: 生物学是研究生物功能的学科。

example.cn: 我每天早上在公交车上学英语。

syllabusExamples.cn: 今年夏天戴维不知道要去哪里度假。

example.en: We often eat outside during the long summer evenings.
example.cn: 夏天傍晚很长，我们常在户外吃饭。

syllabusExamples.en: I want to sit in the sun.
syllabusExamples.cn: 我想在太阳下面坐一坐。

example.en: The sun appeared just as we reached the beach.
example.cn: 我们刚到海滩，太阳就出来了。

syllabusExamples.cn: 从学校到最近的超市有多远？

example.en: We stopped at the supermarket to buy milk and rice.
example.cn: 我们顺路去超市买了牛奶和大米。

syllabusExamples.cn: 没有人教我如何游泳。我是自学的。

syllabusExamples.en: When can we go for a swim?
syllabusExamples.cn: 我们什么时候可以去游泳？

example.cn: 我们每周六早上都在室内泳池游泳。

syllabusExamples.en: This ticket belongs to my brother. Yours is on the table.
syllabusExamples.cn: 这张票是我兄弟的。你的在桌子上。

example.en: We gathered around the table to share fresh bread.
example.cn: 我们围坐在桌边，一起吃新鲜面包。

syllabusExamples.en: The President gave a talk on TV.
syllabusExamples.cn: 总统在电视上作了一次演讲。

syllabusExamples.en: Sure,you can talk to me!
syllabusExamples.cn: 你当然可以和我讲话！

example.en: We talked about our weekend plans over breakfast.
example.cn: 我们吃早饭时聊了聊周末的计划。

syllabusExamples.en: Tea is the most popular drink in the world besides water.
syllabusExamples.cn: 除了水，茶是世界上最流行的饮料。

example.en: I made a pot of tea while you rested.
example.cn: 你休息的时候，我泡了一壶茶。

syllabusExamples.cn: 直到老师教他如何做实验，埃里克才开始动手。

example.en: Our teacher brought a plant into class today.
example.cn: 我们的老师今天带了一株植物来上课。

example.en: We watched a wildlife programme on television after dinner.
example.cn: 晚饭后我们在电视上看了一档野生动物节目。

syllabusExamples.en: Who can tell me the meaning of that sign?
syllabusExamples.cn: 谁能告诉我那个标志的含义？

syllabusExamples.en: What useful information my father has told me!
syllabusExamples.cn: 父亲告诉了我多么有用的信息啊！

syllabusExamples.en: Mrs.White often tells Mike not to drive too fast.

example.en: Please tell me what happened at school today.
example.cn: 请告诉我今天在学校发生了什么。

syllabusExamples.en: Either measure the temperature with a thermometer or test the water with your wrist.
syllabusExamples.cn: 要么用温度计测量水温，要么用你的手腕来试水温。

syllabusExamples.en: The teacher wondered if Edward had corrected his mistakes in the test paper.
syllabusExamples.cn: 老师想知道爱德华是否已纠正试卷上的错误了。

example.en: I have a spelling test at school tomorrow.
example.cn: 我明天在学校有拼写测验。

syllabusExamples.en: —Would you pass me something to drink? I'm a bit thirsty.

example.en: I felt thirsty after walking home in the sun.
example.cn: 我顶着太阳走回家后觉得口渴。

syllabusExamples.en: Sarah doesn't know how she can book a plane ticket by telephone.

syllabusExamples.cn: 萨拉不知道怎样通过电话预订机票。

example.en: I bought a return ticket from the station machine.
example.cn: 我在车站的售票机上买了一张往返票。

syllabusExamples.cn: 森林里有老虎。

example.en: The tiger rested in the shade beside a pool.
example.cn: 那只老虎在水池旁的阴凉处休息。

syllabusExamples.cn: 对每个人来说，餐后刷牙是必要的。

example.en: The dentist checked each tooth with a small mirror.
example.cn: 牙医用一面小镜子检查了每颗牙齿。

syllabusExamples.cn: 乘火车旅游比乘飞机便宜。

syllabusExamples.en: Has the train from Xizang arrived? I'm looking forward to meeting my old friends.
syllabusExamples.cn: 从西藏来的火车到了吗？我期待着见到我的老朋友们。

syllabusExamples.en: He is training for the astronaut.
syllabusExamples.cn: 他为成为宇航员正在接受培训。

example.en: We caught the last train home after dinner.
example.cn: 晚饭后，我们赶上了回家的末班火车。

syllabusExamples.en: Travel broadens the mind.
syllabusExamples.cn: 旅行使人心胸开阔。

syllabusExamples.en: Most people think that travelling abroad can enrich one's knowledge.
syllabusExamples.cn: 大多数人认为，出国旅游可以丰富自己的知识。

syllabusExamples.en: I would rather travel by train than by plane.
syllabusExamples.cn: 我宁愿乘火车也不愿乘飞机旅行。

example.cn: 我们通常坐火车去看望祖父母。

syllabusExamples.en: How often do the students in our school plant trees?
syllabusExamples.cn: 我们学校的学生多久种一次树？

example.en: A small bird built its nest in our tree.
example.cn: 一只小鸟在我们家的树上筑了巢。

syllabusExamples.cn: 在即将到来的二月，我们将有一次为期一周的家庭之旅去哈尔滨。

example.en: Our weekend trip to the coast was wonderfully relaxing.
example.cn: 我们周末的海滨之旅让人十分放松。

syllabusExamples.en: I prefer vegetables to meat because they are good for my health.
syllabusExamples.cn: 比起肉我更喜欢吃蔬菜，因为它们对我的身体健康有好处。

example.en: We bought fresh vegetables at the market this morning.
example.cn: 我们今天早上在市场买了新鲜蔬菜。

syllabusExamples.en: Mary plays the violin very well.
syllabusExamples.cn: 玛丽小提琴拉得很好。

example.en: My sister practises the violin after dinner every evening.
example.cn: 我姐姐每天晚饭后都练习小提琴。

syllabusExamples.en: The wall was painted blue.
syllabusExamples.cn: 墙壁被漆成蓝色。

syllabusExamples.en: He who has never been to the Great Wall is not a true man.
syllabusExamples.cn: 不到长城非好汉。

example.en: We hung a colourful painting on the kitchen wall.
example.cn: 我们在厨房墙上挂了一幅色彩鲜艳的画。

syllabusExamples.en: It is warm in spring.
syllabusExamples.cn: 春天天气暖和。

syllabusExamples.en: The sun's rays helped warm the earth after a long winter.
syllabusExamples.cn: 漫长的冬季过后，太阳的光线帮助温暖了大地。

example.en: This thick blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
example.cn: 这条厚毯子让我在凉飕飕的夜晚保持暖和。

syllabusExamples.en: Mum has washed the carpet twice and now it's spotlessly clean.
syllabusExamples.cn: 妈妈把地毯洗了两次，现在是一尘不染。

syllabusExamples.en: I need to give my car a good wash this weekend.
syllabusExamples.cn: 这周末我得好好洗一下车。

example.en: Please wash your hands before you help prepare dinner.
example.cn: 帮忙准备晚餐前，请先洗手。

syllabusExamples.en: Charlie found that he had the same watch as the driver.
syllabusExamples.cn: 查利发现他有块和司机一样的手表。

syllabusExamples.en: Watch your step! The floor is very slippery.
syllabusExamples.cn: 当心脚下！地板很滑。

example.en: We watched the ducks swimming across the quiet pond.
example.cn: 我们看着鸭子游过平静的池塘。

syllabusExamples.en: Frank held his breath under the water to search for his ring in the swimming pool.
syllabusExamples.cn: 弗兰克在水下屏住呼吸，在游泳池里寻找他的戒指。

syllabusExamples.en: Please tell me whether you have watered the flowers.
syllabusExamples.cn: 请告诉我你是否已给花浇过水了。

example.en: Please water the plants before we leave today.
example.cn: 今天出门前请给植物浇水。

syllabusExamples.en: I don't like the weather in February this year because there were many rainy days.
syllabusExamples.cn: 我不喜欢今年2月的天气，因为有很多雨天。

syllabusExamples.en: What fine weather! Let's go to fly kites.
syllabusExamples.cn: 多么好的天气啊！ 我们去放风筝吧。

example.en: The weather turned sunny just before our picnic.
example.cn: 就在我们野餐前，天气转晴了。

syllabusExamples.en: Wind is a motive power.
syllabusExamples.cn: 风是一种动力。

example.en: A sudden gust of wind blew my hat away.
example.cn: 突然一阵风把我的帽子吹走了。

syllabusExamples.en: Could you possibly open that window for me?
syllabusExamples.cn: 你能为我打开那扇窗吗？

example.en: Please open the window and let some fresh air in.
example.cn: 请打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。

syllabusExamples.en: Miss Lin asked Dick if he was going to visit the Great Wall this winter.
syllabusExamples.cn: 林小姐问迪克今年冬天他是否要去游览长城。

example.en: We wear thick coats when winter brings cold winds.
example.cn: 冬天寒风来袭时，我们会穿上厚外套。

syllabusExamples.en: These women doctors have saved many children's lives since they worked in the hospital.
syllabusExamples.cn: 自从这些女医生在医院工作，她们救了很多孩子的生命。

syllabusExamples.en: Many women are more independent than before because they have jobs and earn money.
syllabusExamples.cn: 许多妇女比以前更独立，因为她们有工作、能赚钱。

example.en: The woman next door grows beautiful flowers on her balcony.
example.cn: 隔壁那位女士在阳台上种了漂亮的花。

syllabusExamples.en: He wrote his first symphony when he was 16.
syllabusExamples.cn: 他16岁时写了自己的第一部交响曲。

syllabusExamples.en: She has written four novels.
syllabusExamples.cn: 她写了4篇小说。

syllabusExamples.en: I wrote to let him know that I had arrived in Beijing.
syllabusExamples.cn: 我写信告诉他我已到达北京。

example.en: Please write your address on this small card.
example.cn: 请把你的地址写在这张小卡片上。

syllabusExamples.en: The production of this factory is less than that of that factory.
syllabusExamples.cn: 这个工厂的产量少于那个工厂。

example.en: Please put less sugar in my tea this time.
example.cn: 这次请在我的茶里少放点糖。

syllabusExamples.en: Cows supply us with milk.
syllabusExamples.cn: 奶牛供给我们牛奶。

example.en: A brown cow stood quietly beside the farm gate.
example.cn: 一头棕色母牛静静地站在农场门旁。

syllabusExamples.en: He brought out a notebook and a pen from his pocket.
syllabusExamples.cn: 他从口袋里掏出笔记本和钢笔。

example.en: She keeps a small notebook beside her bed.
example.cn: 她在床边放着一本小笔记本。

syllabusExamples.en: It is my duty to report it to the police.
syllabusExamples.cn: 把事件报告给警方是我的责任。

example.en: The police helped us find our missing bicycle.
example.cn: 警方帮我们找到了丢失的自行车。

syllabusExamples.en: I shall tell you a story about four little rabbits.
syllabusExamples.cn: 我要给你讲一个4只小兔子的故事。

example.en: A white rabbit hopped across the grass towards us.
example.cn: 一只白兔蹦蹦跳跳地穿过草地，朝我们跑来。

syllabusExamples.en: He lay down on the sofa and soon fell asleep.
syllabusExamples.cn: 他在沙发上躺下，很快就睡着了。

example.en: We curled up on the sofa after dinner.
example.cn: 晚饭后，我们蜷坐在沙发上。

syllabusExamples.en: There is a cat on the roof.
syllabusExamples.cn: 屋顶上有一只猫。

example.en: Rain drummed on the roof throughout the night.
example.cn: 雨点整夜敲打着屋顶。

syllabusExamples.en: We saw a group of zebras in the zoo.
syllabusExamples.cn: 我们在动物园里看到了一群斑马。

example.en: A zebra stood quietly beside the watering hole.
example.cn: 一匹斑马静静地站在水塘旁。

syllabusExamples.en: This is a new device for measuring temperature.
syllabusExamples.cn: 这是一种测量温度的新仪器。

example.en: This tiny device tracks my steps throughout the day.
example.cn: 这个小装置会记录我一整天的步数。
